items.title: What if angles were metric?
items.description: Need custom machined parts? Go to https://pcbway.com/g/RE6Nqt and use code PCBWay-NotAnEngineer10 for $10 off orders over $30. Try Onshape Professional, free for up to six months: https://onshape.pro/NotanEngineer Isn’t it kinda strange that there’s a thousand grams in a kilogram, a thousand millimetres in a metre, but 360 degrees in a circle?
